I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase, especially with plants that you’re investing time and care into.

A couple things about our quality that may help:

All of our roses are grown on their own roots (not grafted), here at our nurseries in Oregon. That means they are true to variety and naturally more resilient over time.
We do not buy from outside growers, so everything is grown and cared for by our team until it ships.
Plants are shipped in containers with soil, defoliated on purpose so they travel well and put their energy into new growth once planted.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, perennials for 90 days, and bulbs by a failure-to-bloom guarantee, so our garden advisors can work with you if something does not perform as expected.

I’d love to help you choose something that really fits your needs so this experience is different from the past ones.
